android_jni_check.name: Check JNI natives are in ffi.FFI
android_jni_check.run:
bad=0
grep -rnE --include='*.rs' 'fn Java_' src libs | grep -v 'fn Java_ffi_FFI_' && bad=1
grep -rl --include='*.kt' 'external fun' flutter/android \
  | grep -vx 'flutter/android/app/src/main/kotlin/ffi.kt' && bad=1
grep -rn --include='*.rs' 'com/carriez' src libs && bad=1
if [ "$bad" = 1 ]; then
  echo "::error::Declare Android natives in ffi.FFI, export them as Java_ffi_FFI_*, and do not look up app classes by name (see AGENTS.md)"
  exit 1
fi
